note: Official merit pages checked October 14, 2026. Automatic consideration is not an automatic award. Deadlines for separate scholarships are distinct from admission deadlines. NC residency does not establish citizenship or financial eligibility.

carnegie-mellon.note: Presidential Scholarship discontinued for incoming students from 2019-20. FAFSA + CSS, no separate app, 8 semesters. CMU is essentially need-based.
carnegie-mellon.deadline_note: No separate Carnegie Scholarship application; FAFSA + CSS required. Preferred aid deadlinesNov15ED /Feb15RD verified on current SFSpage; year mapping inferred.
carnegie-mellon.eligibility: Qualified U.S. citizens and permanent residents; middle-income students; satisfactory academic progress.

purdue.flagship_amount: Full COA for BS + master's/MBA/doctoral + one study abroad
purdue.auto_criteria: Trustees $16k/yr nonres / $10k res; Presidential $10k nonres / $4k res; automatic, no separate app; Nov 1 deadline; renew 3.00 GPA. About 15% of applicants get merit.
purdue.oos_specific: Trustees & Presidential explicitly larger for out-of-state students.
purdue.note: Beering is invite-only via Honors College Nov 1 application; Trustees & Presidential are automatic.
purdue.deadline_note: Complete admission by Nov 1 for university-wide merit. Honors portion by Nov 1 for invitation-based Beering/Stamps consideration. FAFSA priority Apr 15; need-based scholarship timing may differ.
purdue.eligibility: Nonresident Trustees $16k/year, Presidential $10k/year; competitive review, about 15% of applicants receive merit. Renewability requirements apply.

wpi.flagship_amount: Varies; min $25,000/yr guaranteed for IB Diploma ≥40 (4 yrs)
wpi.ed_specific: All ED admits from fall 2026 onward receive min $25,000/yr merit ($100k over 4 yrs). Not combinable with the Innovation Award.
wpi.auto_criteria: Presidential is automatic with application (no extra app except FIRST/VEX/REC).
wpi.note: Student selected EA I, so the binding ED-only $25,000 minimum does not apply. Robotics Engineering Scholars automatic consideration differs from FIRST/VEX/REC separate scholarships.
wpi.deadline_note: General merit automatic with admissions; Robotics Engineering Scholars require indicated intended major. FIRST/VEX/REC separate applications, but live page still has closed 2025-26 deadlines—Fall 2027 scholarship deadline unpublished.
wpi.eligibility: Robotics Engineering intended major for Robotics Engineering Scholars; FIRST/VEX/REC team/mentor nomination requirements are award-specific. ED minimum applies to binding ED, not chosen EA I.

rpi.auto_criteria: No student application — high school nominates one junior; nominations due May 1.
rpi.note: For this senior applicant, the spring junior-year Medal nomination window has passed unless already nominated. General competitive merit remains relevant; institutional merit awards do not stack.
rpi.deadline_note: Medal is high-school nomination in spring of junior year, not a new senior-year application. General merit reviewed with admission; verify award-specific cycle deadlines.
rpi.eligibility: Medalists must be admitted and enroll; $40,000/year four years. RPI awards highest qualifying merit award, not multiple institutional merit awards stacked.

georgia-tech.auto_criteria: Apply by Early Action; no separate app; semifinalist interviews late Jan, Stamps Weekend mid-March.
georgia-tech.oos_specific: OOS Stamps recipients get a tuition waiver to the in-state rate.
named_awards: No other significant merit programs published with amounts
georgia-tech.note: Georgia Tech is otherwise essentially need-only. Stamps is a needle-mover if you win it.
georgia-tech.deadline_note: NC applicant uses EA2 Nov 2 for Stamps/Gold consideration; no separate initial scholarship application. EA2 document deadline Nov 16; scores Dec 8.
georgia-tech.eligibility: Generally new U.S. citizen/permanent-resident first-year students; rare international exceptions.

michigan.flagship_amount: LSA historical award amounts must not be presented as Engineering awards
michigan.auto_criteria: LSA prospective students submit a separate scholarship application after admission; Engineering awards require college-specific verification.
michigan.oos_specific: Nonresident aid is limited and college-specific.
michigan.note: Robotics Engineering applicants should use Engineering scholarship information. LSA official page states 2027-28 applications open after admission.
michigan.deadline_note: Engineering awards must be checked with Engineering. LSA separate Four-Year Renewable Scholarship application opens after admission for 2027-28; do not treat LSA awards as Engineering awards.
michigan.eligibility: College- and donor-specific; NC applicant is nonresident. LSA merit supports LSA students, not a substitute for Engineering eligibility.

maryland.flagship_amount: Up to full tuition, fees, housing, food + book allowance
maryland.ed_specific: Nov 1 EA required for Banneker/Key consideration.
maryland.auto_criteria: President's $2,000-$20,000/yr for 4 yrs (in- and out-of-state); Dean's $1,500 or $4,500/yr for 2 yrs (in-state only, ~400/yr, not renewable).
maryland.oos_specific: President's open to OOS students; Dean's is in-state only.
maryland.note: EA deadline is a hard gate — miss it and you're out for merit.
maryland.deadline_note: Admission application AND all materials due Nov 1 for merit; no separate initial application. Banneker/Key semifinalist interviews follow; page still shows 2026 interview dates, not 2027 dates.
maryland.eligibility: U.S. citizens and eligible noncitizens; fall entrants. President’s eligible for NC residents; Dean’s restricted to Maryland residents.

northeastern.auto_criteria: General merit considers all applicants meeting RD deadline Jan 1, no separate app. No dollar amounts published.
named_awards: Torch Scholars (full tuition/fees/housing/meals + Summer Immersion; requires non-family nomination)
northeastern.note: Third-party sources put general merit in the $10k-$30k/yr range, but that's not on Northeastern's official page.
northeastern.deadline_note: General merit: admission by Jan 1; no separate initial application. Select Stamps candidates invited to video application. Torch requires nomination; exact current deadline must be checked.
northeastern.eligibility: Award- and entry-program-specific; do not infer Oakland/Torch eligibility solely from NC residency.

ohio-state.flagship_amount: Full COA + up to $5,000 enrichment, 8 semesters
ohio-state.auto_criteria: Separate app: admission by Nov 1, scholarship by Nov 9; essay + video; renew 3.4/3.5. National Buckeye (non-Ohio) up to $13,500/yr; Maximus/Provost/Trustees $1k-$3k/yr auto-awarded.
named_awards: President's Ohio (full COA + $5k; ACT 36 or SAT 1600 single sitting, Ohio residents, automatic)
Land Grant Opportunity (full COA, 88 Ohio students/yr)
ohio-state.note: National Buckeye offers automatic consideration by Nov 1, not guaranteed selection; budget the published sticker cost until an award is offered.
ohio-state.deadline_note: Complete admission by Nov 1 for most merit. Stamps Eminence separate essay/video application due Nov 9; indicate Honors or Scholars interest. National Buckeye automatic consideration, competitive award.
ohio-state.eligibility: Non-Ohio applicant eligible to compete for National Buckeye, not Ohio-resident President’s Ohio/Land Grant awards. University merit excludes international students.

nc-state.flagship_amount: ≈$129k in-state / ≈$244k OOS over 4 yrs (tuition, fees, room/board, books, travel, computer, enrichment)
nc-state.auto_criteria: ~38/yr, any discipline; semifinalists get guaranteed University Honors Program invitation.
nc-state.oos_specific: Park value is scaled up for OOS (≈$244k).
named_awards: Goodnight Scholarships — $25,000/year ×4 (NC residents; eligible STEM/STEM education; household income ≤$150,000)
nc-state.note: Park is extremely selective but comprehensive. Goodnight is a strong NC-STEM alternative.
nc-state.deadline_note: Park: separate scholarship application AND NC State EA due Nov 1, 2026. Goodnight invitation mid-December; self-nomination closes Dec 1; application due mid-January (exact date not published), finalist interview Feb 27, 2027.
nc-state.eligibility: Park selection based on scholarship, leadership, service and character. Goodnight: NC resident, eligible STEM/STEM education major, household income ≤$150,000; invitation not guaranteed.

duke.flagship_amount: Full tuition, mandatory fees, room and board for four years (Duke-administered merit; amounts vary with annual costs)
duke.auto_criteria: Duke-administered merit awards require no separate application; Robertson has a separate application/selection process.
named_awards: Robertson Scholars — full-ride across Duke AND UNC (joint program)
Benjamin N. Duke Scholarship (Carolinas students, full tuition + stipends)
duke.note: Robertson is a marquee scholarship nationally — the only cross-institutional full-ride between Duke and UNC. A.B. Duke has no separate application.
duke.deadline_note: Duke-administered merit: no separate application. Robertson is a separate program; current program deadline could not be verified, so prior Nov 15 is not a confirmed 2026 deadline.
duke.eligibility: Award-specific; Benjamin N. Duke focuses on North/South Carolina students. Selection is highly competitive.

rose-hulman.auto_criteria: Historical evidence describes automatic general-merit consideration with admission; current amounts and renewal rules pending confirmation. FIRST is a separate competitive award.
named_awards: FIRST Robotics Scholarship (competitive; current amount pending confirmation)
Competition Teams Scholarship (separate award; current terms pending confirmation)
rose-hulman.note: Historical FIRST evidence describes two $10,000-per-year scholarships renewable up to $40,000 over four years; current award count, amount, deadline, renewal and stacking need confirmation. Participation is not an automatic award. The historical Provost award is tied to biology/chemistry/biochemistry and is not assumed available to CE.
rose-hulman.deadline_note: Historical FIRST deadline was February 1; current-cycle deadline unconfirmed. Competition Teams historically used a separate April 1 date.
rose-hulman.eligibility: Historical FIRST rules describe admitted high-school FIRST participants and a separate applicant-portal application. Confirm current eligibility and award terms.

michigan-dearborn.offers_merit: Historical awards documented; current availability unknown
michigan-dearborn.note: Earlier nonresident award amounts conflict with an inaccessible-source report, so no current amount, eligibility, renewal, stacking or automatic award is asserted. Confirm institutional nonresident merit separately from CECS awards. Michigan-resident aid must not be assumed to apply to a North Carolina applicant.
michigan-dearborn.deadline_note: Current admission, scholarship and aid dates need confirmation; inherited aid-priority records conflict.
